issues.description: setIsMounted is not defined - repeated 14+ times in page errors. This causes hydration failures across the app.
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/auth/page.tsx, a useEffect or similar hook references setIsMounted but the useState hook for isMounted was not declared, or the state setter was destructured incorrectly.

issues.description: React hydration error - text content does not match server-rendered HTML, causing entire root to switch to client rendering. Related to the missing isMounted state.
issues.root_cause: The auth page likely uses isMounted to conditionally render content (e.g., to avoid SSR mismatch), but since setIsMounted is undefined, the state never updates and the server/client HTML diverges.

issues.description: step-7c page crash with unrecoverable error in NotFoundErrorBoundary, causing full page reload. Component Step7cKeepOrRemove threw an error.
issues.root_cause: The Step7cKeepOrRemove component at line 108 throws an error (likely also related to setIsMounted not being defined or another runtime error in that component).

fixes.reason: setIsMounted is referenced but the useState declaration for isMounted is missing. Adding the state declaration fixes the ReferenceError and resolves the hydration mismatch.
